scope: Small source-only review during exclusive runtime window. No operation, process scan, Docker, test, archive/tree hash or configuration change.

findings.finding: Imported Monitor.__exit__ unconditionally joins its thread before outer own-client settlement is reached. Synchronous disk/log I/O blocking that thread can therefore hold the operation before stop_owned. Later archive verification and full-file hashing are also synchronous.
findings.required: Use separate reviewed own-child/group watchdog for elapsed failure/settlement, retaining I/O scheduling and daemon-drain uncertainty. Do not present monitor timeout=600 as a hard wall bound for the whole archive procedure.

findings.finding: stop_owned catches only ProcessLookupError. Other signal or wait exceptions can escape both inner and outer cleanup calls and prevent the stage failed receipt, masking the original export error.
findings.required: Settlement should return explicit failure/unknown observation without escaping; failure receipt must retain original failure even when settlement itself fails. Do not infer daemon drain or descendant absence from child exit.

confirmed: Exact760 image config, rootfs layer diffIDs, runtime file bytes/modes/ownership and gzip CRC are checked by the reused archive verifier before complete archive/pins are staged.

LimitedWriter rejects an over-bound compressed write before forwarding it. The compressed limit is 1288490188 bytes; failure retains the partial path and does not update saved setup. Raw exported bytes are also bounded.
Initial admission requires unchanged 3905250841-byte export floor on both known filesystems, plus the compressed output cap on root; this arithmetic does not assume compression will fit.
Exact historical333 archive plus old setup are retained before export; publication checks archive hash and saved source/pin identities before any per-file replacement.
Publication declares individual atomic replacements rather than a multi-file transaction, preserves original/new files and publication-interrupted state, and has no automatic retry/rollback.
Docker client uses explicit Unix endpoint with fresh constrained environment and exact engine ID, and refuses a nonempty daemon.
scopeLimits: Imported active monitor uses STOP_RESERVE=1342177280 bytes on root and TMP, not the 3905250841 initial admission floor. Preserve admission-floor versus cancellation-reserve distinction; no claim of continuous 3.905GB free space.
The draft does not establish future Docker admission, daemon request drain, fresh docker load, runtime behavior, Windows, performance or full product acceptance.
No broad filesystem attacker model or independent proof of current private directory contents was evaluated. Source/evidence checks at actual execution remain required.
